# #10 Paste / drop image — blind adversarial QA

**Verdict: FAIL** (3 major defects, all in undo/redo around uploads; every AC passes).
Method: throwaway stack (`scripts/lib/stack.sh run`), Playwright drivers in `.verify/qa/10/{a..f}.mjs` (under `browser-slot.sh`), synthetic `ClipboardEvent`/`DragEvent` carrying `File`s on `.cm-content`, uploads held/failed via `page.route`. Server ACs checked with curl. src/ and the diff were not read.

## Acceptance criteria
- AC-10.1 PASS: `assets/20261010-200629-10ceb5.png`, base64, sent to the canonical id with `X-Edit-Token`. The inserted URL is absolute and exact.
- AC-10.2 PASS: placeholder `![Uploading shot…]()` appeared after 20 ms. After the response there is no `Uploading` text left.
- AC-10.3 PASS: typing `ABCDE` on the line above left `# TABCDEitle…two![shot](…)` exact.
- AC-10.4 PASS: doc is back to its pre-paste text. Toast is error/alert: "Couldn't upload shot: disk full".
- AC-10.5 PASS: one undo gives the pre-paste text. Redo gives the final markup, never the placeholder.
- AC-10.6 PASS: 3 dropped files land at the drop line in order, separated by `\n\n`, even when they resolve in reverse order. One undo removes all three.
- AC-10.7 PASS: an 11 MiB file sends no request and shows "big.png is larger than 10 MB". Exactly 10 MiB is accepted; 10 MiB + 1 is rejected.
- AC-10.8 PASS: only the PNG uploads. Toasts: "Unsupported image type: pic.bmp" and "Skipped 1 non-image file(s)".
- AC-10.9 PASS: PNG plus TSV text pasted the TSV text, with no upload.
- AC-10.10 PASS at 1400 and 390: dialog text is exact, `role=dialog aria-modal`, focus lands on confirm, focus is trapped, no POST is sent. Cancel and Esc close it with the doc unchanged. A drop on an unshared doc also opens the dialog.
- AC-10.11 PASS: `POST /paste`, then `/files` on the new id. The image is inserted at the original offset 10, the share dialog opens as usual, and one undo gives the pre-paste text.
- AC-10.12 PASS at 1400, 800 and 390: viewer `img` src equals the inserted URL, naturalWidth is 2400, rendered width is 1336/736/326 (equal to the content width), and there is no horizontal scroll.
- AC-10.13 PASS: inserted `<img src="…" alt="pic &quot;q&quot;">` (quote escaped). It renders in the iframe with naturalWidth 300.
- AC-10.14 PASS: 415 / 413 / 201. Also correct: `x.PNG` gets 201; no extension, `x.png.exe`, `.html` and `../x.exe` get 415; a UTF-8 svg over 10 MiB gets 413; no token gets 401.
- AC-10.15 PASS: svg is served with `image/svg+xml`, `nosniff` and `CSP default-src 'none'; style-src 'unsafe-inline'`. An svg with `<script>` opened directly in a tab did not run.
- AC-10.16 PASS: `role=alert`, the close button works, auto-dismiss took 7.9 s. While the pointer rests on the toast it stays up (looks like hover-pause, which is fine).

## Defects
1. **MAJOR: redo brings back an orphan placeholder for good.** Paste with the upload held, press Ctrl+Z (placeholder gone), let the upload succeed (correctly nothing is inserted), then press Ctrl+Shift+Z. `![Uploading shot…]()` comes back, is never replaced, and is autosaved to the server.
2. **MAJOR: undo then redo during an upload loses the image.** Paste with the upload held, press Ctrl+Z then Ctrl+Shift+Z, then let the upload succeed. The placeholder stays `Uploading…` for good; the file is uploaded but never linked. The range tracking does not survive an undo/redo round-trip. This is a common keystroke pattern.
3. **MAJOR: an image paste over a selection takes 2 undo steps.** Doc `alpha beta gamma`, select `beta`, paste an image: the result is correct. But undo 1 gives `alpha  gamma` and only undo 2 gives `alpha beta gamma`. This breaks rule 10 and §3.6 (one step). A plain-text paste over the same selection undoes in one step (baseline checked).
4. MINOR: Esc on `share-required-dialog` leaves focus on `BODY`, while Cancel returns focus to the editor. Esc should restore focus the same way.
5. MINOR (spec gap): the placeholder is saved to the server mid-upload. If the user navigates to another doc or closes the tab mid-upload, the original doc keeps `![Uploading shot…]()` for good, and readers see it in the meantime. Rule 13 itself holds: nothing landed in the new doc.
6. MINOR (spec gap): a partly edited placeholder (e.g. its trailing `)` deleted) is left as `![Uploading p2…](` with no cleanup.

## Other checks that passed
- Out-of-order completion with typing in between: each image lands in its own placeholder.
- Deleting the placeholder mid-upload: nothing is inserted. If the upload then fails, only the upload toast appears.
- At most 3 uploads in flight. 11 images give 10 plus the toast "Only the first 10 images were added".
- File names: `a]b [x] \ (1) 😀` gives alt `ab x (1) 😀`. No extension, `.JPEG` with an empty type (becomes `.jpg`), `.png` (alt `image`), and webp all work; heic is rejected. The GIF is stored byte-for-byte.
- A non-JSON 502 gives "server error (502)". Offline gives "network error".
- Switching to Read view mid-upload: the image still lands.
- No scroll jump: the scroller stayed at `scrollTop` 10971 and the cursor stayed at the doc end while a placeholder off-screen resolved.
- Phone 390 paste works, and the toast wraps inside the viewport. Dark-theme dialog is fine.
- No page errors in any run.

## Blocked / not tested
- Ctrl+Shift+V plain-paste override: a synthetic event cannot carry the key chord.
- Rule 13 in an editor on the target doc: SPA popstate does not pick up `?edit=`, so this was checked server-side only.
- Detach-from-share: no control found.
- Out of scope: at 390 px on a `?filePath=` review doc, the comments panel covers most of the editor (`c-dialog-390.png`). This is pre-existing layout.

Screenshots: `.verify/qa/10/*.png` (a-error-toast, c-dialog-1400/390, c-share-fail, c-after-confirm, c-scroll-*, c-viewer-*, c-html, f-phone-*, f-dark-dialog).
